rules.reason: The shipped tree reads a workspace at a path given to it; it must not reach into .nit/ by convention, or it stops working on any project but this one.

The workspace is project state and depends on nothing. ADR-0006: .nit/ holds what a project accumulates, not nit's own machinery. The duplicated .nit/skills tree it deleted was exactly this dependency, and it went stale because nothing could see it was wrong.
